description: Look up a Texas barber, cosmetology, school or establishment license in the state regulator's own licensee record — by license number, or by name with an optional city. Returns the license type, number, expiry and whether it had expired as of the data snapshot. Texas only. This reports what TDLR published on the snapshot date; it is not a live check and it does not report disciplinary action or continuing-education status.

city.description: Optional city to narrow a name search.

license_number.description: The license number, if known. Exact match. Fastest and least ambiguous.

limit.description: How many matches to return (1-25, default 10).

name.description: Person or business name, e.g. "Smith" or "Baytown Beauty". TDLR stores people as "LAST, FIRST".

name: verify_texas_license
title: Check a Texas barber or cosmetology license against the TDLR record
